decisions.briefing: Markets ticked up modestly (NASDAQ +0.8%, S&P 500 +0.7%) — a mild risk-on day, not the strong +2% move that would justify aggressive deployment. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 threshold needed to fund a new position, so today is a hold: existing 7 positions stay in place and stop-loss/profit-target rules continue to run automatically in the background.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted higher today with NASDAQ up 0.8% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%, a modest continuation of the recent uptrend rather than a decisive breakout. No single catalyst stands out from today's screen data — this looks like routine grinding-higher price action rather than a news-driven rally. With no major headlines flagged in today's data, the move appears consistent with steady, broad-based buying interest.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和走高，納斯達克指數上漲0.8%，標普500指數上漲0.7%，延續近期的溫和上升趨勢，但未見明顯突破性行情。今日篩選數據中並無特別重大的消息面催化劑，走勢較像是穩定買盤支撐下的緩步上揚，而非消息驅動的急漲。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash held in reserve rather than invested. When your available cash is too small to fund a meaningful new position — like today's $189 versus a $500 threshold — the disciplined move is to hold that cash rather than force a trade, waiting for it to build up or for a stronger signal to deploy it.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是保留而未投入市場的現金。當可用現金太少、不足以建立一個有意義的新倉位時（例如今日僅189美元，遠低於500美元的門檻），紀律的做法是持有現金等待，而不是勉強交易，直到資金累積足夠或出現更強烈的進場訊號。
